about: The character being created, on the server and replicated to the client: Definition.Definition (Race, Subrace, BodyType, BodyShape, RootTemplate, Voice, Origin, Background, Deity), Definition.Visual (Visuals, Elements, AdditionalChoices, EyeColor, SecondEyeColor, HairColor, SkinColor), Definition.Name, Definition.Abilities, Definition.LevelUpData. The created character's CharacterCreationAppearance and CharacterCreationStats are made from it at FinishCreating.

evidence.says: Script Extender exposes it as CCCharacterDefinition

written on the server and replicated, the client's copy of this component changes and neither the dummy nor the creation window follows; changed by the client's own message, the created character carries its Visual, Name and Abilities
Script Extender's header Components/CharacterCreation.h binds CCCharacterDefinition to this engine name; the offsets are the ones its legacy field names carry (field_28C, field_290)
no entity carries it in a change-appearance session started on a running level: it belongs to the creation of a new character
reported from a run of character creation, not read again here: a server write of Definition followed by Replicate changes the client's replicated copy and neither the dummy nor the window
